meta.title: Order Activity records publishing the event
gaps: Verify the publishing entry includes the exact actor who published the event and the exact date and time.
Verify all earlier activities are present with nothing missing and that entries are in chronological order.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify the publishing entry includes the exact actor who published the event and the exact date and time.; Verify all earlier activities are present with nothing missing and that entries are in chronological order.

steps.note: Start a new multi-stage event for the publishing activity test.
Provide the required event title so publishing can proceed.
Configure the event with the RFQ stage needed for the test event.
Apply the first available RFQ template before adding line items.
Add the required line item to make the event publishable.
Commit a valid event schedule before publishing.
Invite one QA vendor so the event has participants.
Publish the event, which should create the Order Activity record.
Confirm publishing completed and the project page is available.
Open the stage Settings menu and select Order Activity.
Verify the activity drawer contains the publishing activity entry.
